def transform(grid):
    """Compare aligned cells on either side of the center divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    mid = w // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    common.discard(grid[0][mid])
    mismatch = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a == b else mismatch for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
